episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the importance of relationship-building and personal branding for agents. The conversation also covers the future dynamics of Zillow and MLS feeds, as well as the potential for independent brokerages to form alliances against large corporate entities. Key strategies include leveraging social media for personal branding and preparing for industry shifts driven by AI.
